Charlotte Alter is a journalist and author. Her forthcoming novel See Jane Run, will be published by St. Martin’s Press in 2027, the first in a series of humanist thrillers.
Her 2020 political nonfiction book, The Ones We’ve Been Waiting For: How a New Generation of Leaders Will Transform America (Viking) charts the way gerontocracy threatens democracy and chronicles the rising generation of young political leaders .
She was most recently a Senior Correspondent at TIME, where she worked from 2013-2025. While there, she covered three presidential elections, launched a podcast and wrote 18 cover stories. She is the recipient of the Newswomen’s Club’s Front Page Award for Best Magazine Feature (2023) and for Specialized Reporting in Politics (2024). Her work has also appeared in The New York Times, The Washington Post, The Wall Street Journal , and Vox. She lives in Brooklyn with her husband, the journalist and author Mark Chiusano, and their two children.
